description:
Title: Car Service

The police has a new app to remind you of your car service.
The process is started after a successful service.
When a service is necessary, the system checks if your car is still registered.
If it is registered, you are notified.
If you do not go to the service, you are fined after 30 days.
At the car service facility the mechanic enters the problems of your car for reference.
While you wait (can take several days), you get status updates via email.
You can pay through the app, when the repair is done.
The mechanic enters that the repair was successful and you got your "Pickerl".
The mechanic enters the time for you next service.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_CarService" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/car-service">

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ServiceSuccessful" name="Service successful"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_CarBrought" name="Car brought to service"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_CarArrived" name="Car arrived at facility"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_StatusUpdate" name="Status update email"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RepairDone" name="Repair done"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CarService" name="Car Service">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PoliceApp" name="Police app" processRef="Process_PoliceApp"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Facility" name="Car service facility" processRef="Process_Facility"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Owner" name="Car owner"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ServiceSuccessful" name="Service successful" sourceRef="EndEvent_ServiceSuccessful" targetRef="StartEvent_ServiceSuccessful" messageRef="Msg_ServiceSuccessful"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_NotifyOwner" name="Service reminder" sourceRef="Task_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Participant_Owner"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_CarBrought" name="Car brought to service" sourceRef="Participant_Owner" targetRef="Catch_CarBrought" messageRef="Msg_CarBrought"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_CarArrived" name="Car arrived" sourceRef="Participant_Owner" targetRef="StartEvent_CarArrived" messageRef="Msg_CarArrived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_StatusUpdate" name="Status update email" sourceRef="Task_SendStatus" targetRef="Catch_StatusUpdate" messageRef="Msg_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RepairDone" name="Repair done" sourceRef="Throw_RepairDone" targetRef="Catch_RepairDone" messageRef="Msg_RepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Fine" name="Fine" sourceRef="Task_IssueFine" targetRef="Participant_Owner"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_PoliceApp" name="Police app" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ServiceSuccessful" name="Service successful">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ServiceSuccessful" messageRef="Msg_ServiceSuccessful"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckRegistration" name="Check if car is still registered?"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Registered" name="Car still registered?" default="Flow_NotRegistered"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotRegistered" name="Car not registered"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyOwner" name="Notify owner of service due"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_ServiceVisit" name="Service visit or timeout"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_CarBrought" name="Car brought to service">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CarBrought" messageRef="Msg_CarBrought"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Timer_30Days" name="30 days elapsed">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_30Days">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P30D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_IssueFine" name="Issue fine to owner"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Fined" name="Owner fined"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Updates_Merge" name="Waiting for repair"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_Updates" name="Status update or repair done"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_StatusUpdate" name="Status update received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_StatusUpdate" messageRef="Msg_StatusUpdate"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_RepairDone" name="Repair done">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_RepairDone" messageRef="Msg_RepairDone"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Pay" name="Pay repair via app"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Paid" name="Repair paid"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToCheck" sourceRef="StartEvent_ServiceSuccessful" targetRef="Task_CheckRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckToGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegistration" targetRef="Gateway_Registered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Registered" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="Task_NotifyOwner">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${registered}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotRegistered" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="End_NotRegistered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifyToVisit" sourceRef="Task_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Gateway_ServiceVisit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VisitCar" sourceRef="Gateway_ServiceVisit" targetRef="Catch_CarBrought"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VisitTimer" sourceRef="Gateway_ServiceVisit" targetRef="Timer_30Days"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TimerToFine" sourceRef="Timer_30Days" targetRef="Task_IssueFine"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FineToEnd" sourceRef="Task_IssueFine" targetRef="End_Fined"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CarToUpdatesMerge" sourceRef="Catch_CarBrought" targetRef="Gateway_Updates_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToUpdates" sourceRef="Gateway_Updates_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Updates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdatesToStatus" sourceRef="Gateway_Updates" targetRef="Catch_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdatesToRepairDone" sourceRef="Gateway_Updates" targetRef="Catch_RepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusToMerge" sourceRef="Catch_StatusUpdate" targetRef="Gateway_Updates_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairDoneToPay" sourceRef="Catch_RepairDone" targetRef="Task_Pay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PayToEnd" sourceRef="Task_Pay" targetRef="End_Paid"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Facility" name="Car service facility" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Facility">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Mechanic" name="Mechanic">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_CarArrived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterProblems</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterSuccess</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterNextService</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_FacilitySystem" name="Facility system">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Wait_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendStatus</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RepairDone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Throw_RepairDone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_ServiceSuccessful</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CarArrived" name="Car arrived">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CarArrived" messageRef="Msg_CarArrived"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterProblems" name="Enter car problems for reference"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Wait_Merge" name="Waiting for repair"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendStatus" name="Send status update via email"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RepairDone" name="Repair finished?" default="Flow_RepairNotDone"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterSuccess" name="Enter successful repair and issue Pickerl"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent id="Throw_RepairDone" name="Repair done">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_RepairDoneThrow" messageRef="Msg_RepairDone"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterNextService" name="Enter time of next service"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ServiceSuccessful" name="Service successful">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ServiceSuccessfulEnd" messageRef="Msg_ServiceSuccessful"/>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ArrivedToProblems" sourceRef="StartEvent_CarArrived" targetRef="Task_EnterProblems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProblemsToMerge" sourceRef="Task_EnterProblems" targetRef="Gateway_Wait_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToStatus" sourceRef="Gateway_Wait_Merge" targetRef="Task_SendStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusToCheck" sourceRef="Task_SendStatus" targetRef="Gateway_RepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairNotDone" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairDone" targetRef="Gateway_Wait_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairDone" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairDone" targetRef="Task_EnterSuccess">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${repairFinished}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SuccessToThrow" sourceRef="Task_EnterSuccess" targetRef="Throw_RepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ThrowToNextService" sourceRef="Throw_RepairDone" targetRef="Task_EnterNextService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NextServiceToEnd" sourceRef="Task_EnterNextService" targetRef="EndEvent_ServiceSuccessful"/>
  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>
